capture: Installed Harness v1.0.38 full test sweep fails tests/release-packaging.test.ts because expected package version remains 1.0.35; update release packaging assertion to derive or match committed release metadata, then independently rerun the exact test.

The active-launch, large-prompt, and paste-submit smoke fixtures still launch retired gemini/cursor seats. A bounded attempt to substitute current seats exposed separate fixture contracts: Claude now requires kickoff hook evidence, while the fake Codex app-server path does not keep the tmux session alive. Migrate these producer fakes to current oss/claude/codex startup protocols in a separate operational slice; do not mix this with socket routing or modernization.
